primary.title: PPF: Investing ₹1.5 lakh/year will accumulate this much corpus till your child turns 18 — Check calculations
primary.summary: Today, we take a look at how much annual contributions of ₹50,000, ₹1 lakh and ₹1.5 lakh, made either as lumpsum or monthly credits, can generate for your child over 18 years. We also check how much they can accumulate by continuing the account till retirement…
